summary: News Corp filed an 8-K to disclose routine daily ASX notifications related to its existing stock repurchase program, which authorizes up to $1 billion in buybacks of Class A and Class B common stock. No new share repurchase plan, tender offer, or special capital return event is announced; the filing merely satisfies ASX disclosure rules and includes forward-looking statements. The board did not make a new recommendation, and no advisors are named. This is a routine periodic report, not an activist, going-private, or restructuring event. What to watch: nothing extraordinary, as this is standard buyback administration.
